response.quote_a: All Departments are hereby authorised to incur expenditure on works taken up under Capital Heads based on the original administrative sanctions issued by the Government for the said works without further administrative approval, based on the CBRO issued by the Finance Department.
response.quote_b: Expenditure up to the authorised share may be incurred pending the CBRO.
response.explanation: Document A states that expenditure is authorized based on the issued CBRO, whereas Document B states that expenditure may be incurred pending the CBRO.
